raw_prompt: !create an axe that spawns a pig when I strike another mob
reviewer_feedback: Created a custom 'Pig Axe' that spawns a pig whenever you strike a mob.
usage_instructions: Use /givepigaxe to receive the special axe (requires OP).
Strike any mob (except players) to spawn a pig.

traces.intent_summary: Create a custom axe item that spawns a pig mob whenever the player hits another entity.

traces.rationale: Created a standalone script that handles the item creation via a command and uses the 'on damage' event to check for the specific item name. The logic ensures only mobs are targeted and the axe is identified by its display name as per the constraints.
